test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the word that is opposite in meaning (ANTONYM) to the word given below.**

Celestial
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Terrestrial**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Celestial** means** relating to the sky or the heavens, such as celestial bodies like stars and planets. **(आकाश या स्‍वर्ग से संबंधित)

 
 
• **For example:** "The ***celestial ***bodies in the night sky were breathtaking."
 
 
 
• **Terrestrial**, on the other hand, means** relating to the earth or its inhabitants. **(भौमिक, स्‍थलीय)
 
 
• **For example:** "The ***terrestrial* **animals in the forest were diverse and fascinating."
 
 
 
• Hence the antonym of '**Celestial' **is '**Terrestrial'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option (2)** i.e. **'*Terrestrial'.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Option 1, Heavenly**, is a synonym of Celestial, meaning relating to heaven or the divine. (स्‍वर्ग, आकाश या अंतरिक्ष से संबंधित)

 
 
• For example: "The **heavenly **choir sang beautiful hymns.
 
 
 
• **Option 3, Divine**, is also a synonym of Celestial, meaning relating to God or the gods. (दिव्‍य, दैवी, ईश्‍वरीय)
 
 
• For example: "The **divine **intervention saved the village from disaster."
 
 
 
• **Option 4, Stellar,** is related to Celestial, meaning relating to stars or of exceptional quality. (तारों से संबंधित)
 
 
• For example: "The **stellar **performance of the actor won him an award."
 
 

3d:T930,

The correct answer is **option 4, Endorsement.**
